title: Vityo
goal: Deliver Vityo as the agent-native IDE for Styio, complete without an Agent and reviewable with compatible Agents.
description: The IDE delivery track owns editing, the Styio developer loop, Agent Client and Workbench, workspace revisions and transactions, and desktop delivery; it never owns model/provider, tool-loop, durable-session, or multi-Agent runtime implementation.
purpose: Preserve the completed IDE delivery history and its independently reviewable product evidence.

title: Vityo Coding Agent
goal: Deliver Vityo Coding Agent as the independent, secure, model-neutral first-party companion runtime for Vityo and other compatible clients.
description: The companion-runtime delivery track owns model orchestration, context selection, tools, policy, coding loops, durable sessions, and multi-Agent execution; it never imports Vityo or Flutter implementation and is not a second product identity.
purpose: Preserve the completed companion-runtime delivery history and its independently reviewable evidence.
